titulo: GTA 6’s Jason Can Live His Best Life By Drinking A Beer And Eating A Donut Simultaneously
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 looks like it will have an impressive attention to detail, and that includes how one of the main characters, Jason, can drink a beer and eat a donut at the same time. Now that's living. Rockstar boss Rob Nelson geeked out to The Guardian about GTA 6's finer details, including this one. According to the report, Jason can "take bites of a donut with one hand while sipping a beer with the other." Drink up. It’s unclear whether this is under the player’s active control or it just happens. In any event, the report also mentioned how Rockstar paid close attention to "the way that Jason eats a hot dog." These are very important details. GTA 6 features a body-shaping system, so if Jason, or Lucia, drink a lot of beer and pound hot dogs and donuts, they'll likely gain weight. titulo: GTA 6 Passes 11 Million Copies Sold And $1 Billion In Revenue, And The Game Isn’t Even Out Yet
texto: The video game research company Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker to reveal the latest, albeit unofficial, sales data for the open-world crime game. According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has now sold 11.27 million total units via pre-purchases, which works out to about $1.09 billion in gross revenue. The report said PS5 sales are dominating the mix, with GTA 6 selling 8.46 million units on PS5 so far, compared to 2.81 million on Xbox Series X|S. That means of the 11.27 million GTA 6 sales so far, 75% are on PS5 and 25% on Xbox Series X|S. In total, GTA 6 sales for PS5 have so far reached $821 million in revenue, compared to $272 million for Xbox Series X|S. titulo: GTA 6: What Will Review Scores Be? You Can Win A $500 Gift Card For Getting It Right
texto: Rockstar's long-awaited open-world action game Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and among the many things people are excited to find out is how the game will score with reviewers. Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is currently the No. 1 most highly rated game of 2026 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic , but could GTA 6 dethrone it? You can make a prediction of your own via GameSpot's parent company, Fandom, and score a chance to win a gift card for up to $500. Make your pick. Now through midnight on November 17, you can submit your prediction for GTA 6's score on Metacritic by dragging the slider on the GTA 6 Metascore Prediction page . Selections are editable up until the contest closes. There are three prizes up for grabs in the form of Visa gift cards. titulo: GTA 6 Backflips Look Good Now, But There Could Be More To The Story
texto: A new Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer debuted today, November 10, and the video showed off a race car driver doing a backflip. The animation looks smoooth . That's notable because the Extended Look trailer that debuted back in August showed Jason doing a backflip and people online quickly roasted it for looking ... off. Other said it looked totally fine. Whatever the case, some are saying this new backflip animation being featured in the latest trailer is an example of Rockstar taking feedback seriously, but it could be more nuanced than that. That's a nice backflip. That's because it subsequently came to light that the backflip animation in GTA 6 is controlled by the player and isn't locked to one specific animation.
